summary: Growth and belief support power and transformation. This cooperative pattern asks you to use optimism and depth with awareness.
body: Growth and belief support power and transformation. This cooperative pattern asks you to use optimism and depth with awareness. Transformative ambition pursued with focus. The connection is available when you choose to use it; it works best through deliberate practice. In practice, this can show up through growth and belief, power and transformation, and the choices you make when overreach or control starts running the room.
gift: The gift is optimism, depth, and a more conscious way to work with growth and belief and power and transformation.
shadow: The shadow is overreach, control, and repeating the same pattern without noticing what it is trying to teach.
integration: Let growth and belief and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Big, transformative ambition; the intensity can overshoot.
do: Name how growth and belief and power and transformation are both involved
Turn optimism and depth into one concrete choice
dont: Ignore the needs of growth and belief or power and transformation
